loyaltyProgramme.title: Loyalty Programme
loyaltyProgramme.summary: A native loyalty programme owned by a brand/retailer with configurable points rules, tier rules and redemption options.
loyaltyProgramme.description: A LoyaltyProgramme is the top-level container for one brand/retailer's loyalty economics. It owns its own PointsRule, TierRule and RedemptionOption collections; CustomerLoyaltyAccount links a customer (customerId) to exactly one programme. Status transitions from concept→actief are validated against rule and redemption-option presence (REQ-LOY-001).

activate.description: Activate the programme (validated against rule and redemption-option presence, REQ-LOY-001).

programmeId.description: Stable external identifier for the programme. Used by POS terminals.
programmeId.title: Programme ID

brand.description: Brand or retailer that owns the programme.
brand.title: Merk

endDate.description: ISO-8601 programme end date (null for open-ended).
endDate.title: Einddatum

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code for spend-based rules and liability.
currency.title: Valuta

termsUrl.description: URL to the programme's terms of service for opt-in capture.
termsUrl.title: Terms URL

brandingProfileId.description: Optional FK to a branding profile (logo/colours) for notifications and POS prints.
brandingProfileId.title: Branding Profile ID

pointValue.description: EUR value of one point, used for IFRS 15 / RJ 270 liability calculation (REQ-LOY-009).
pointValue.title: Point Value

advanceNoticeDays.title: Advance Notice Days
advanceNoticeDays.description: Advance Notice Days for this record.

pointsRule.title: Points Rule
pointsRule.summary: A trigger-based rule that awards points; conditions filter applicability, formula derives the amount.
pointsRule.description: PointsRule defines when (trigger), under what conditions (JSON condition), and how many points (JSON formula) are awarded. Rules are evaluated in priority order; the highest-priority matching rule wins (non-cumulative). See REQ-LOY-002.

ruleId.description: Stable external identifier for the rule.
ruleId.title: Rule ID

trigger.description: Event type that fires the rule.
trigger.title: Trigger

condition.description: Optional JSON filter (category, excludeCategory, segment, dayOfWeek, timeRange, channel).
condition.title: Conditie

formula.description: Points formula. Supported types: fixed {value}, percentage {value}, stepped {brackets:[{amount,points}]}.
formula.title: Formule

maxPerCustomerPerPeriod.description: Optional cap on points awarded to a single customer per period (null = no cap).
maxPerCustomerPerPeriod.title: Max Per Customer Per Period

priority.description: Rule priority; HIGHER value wins. Highest-priority matching rule wins (non-cumulative).
priority.title: Prioriteit

tierRule.title: Tier Rule
tierRule.summary: A tier definition with threshold and benefits; benefits modify points multiplier and exclusive offers.
tierRule.description: TierRule defines a tier (e.g. Zilver, Goud, Platina) with a threshold against lifetimePoints, rolling-window points, or annual spend. Benefits include a points multiplier (applied to credit amount) and optional flags such as exclusiveOffers, freeShipping. See REQ-LOY-003.

tierId.description: Stable external identifier for the tier.
tierId.title: Tier ID

sequence.description: Order from lowest to highest; used to walk tiers in calculateTier.
sequence.title: Sequence

benefits.description: Benefits JSON: pointsMultiplier (number), exclusiveOffers (bool), freeShipping (bool), etc.
benefits.title: Benefits

customerLoyaltyAccount.title: Customer Loyalty Account
customerLoyaltyAccount.summary: A customer's enrollment in a loyalty programme; tracks balances, tier, and opt-in.
customerLoyaltyAccount.description: CustomerLoyaltyAccount links one customer (customerId, references a Nextcloud contact UID) to one LoyaltyProgramme. currentBalance and lifetimePoints are denormalised for query performance; the immutable PointsLedgerEntry collection is the source of truth (REQ-LOY-002, REQ-LOY-005). Composite uniqueness on (customerId, programmeId).

currentBalance.description: Denormalised current points balance. Source of truth = sum of PointsLedgerEntry.quantity.
currentBalance.title: Current Balance

lifetimePoints.description: Cumulative points credited (never decreased on debit/expiry); used for tier thresholds.
lifetimePoints.title: Lifetime Points

status.description: Account status. Geblokkerd accounts do not earn points (REQ-LOY-002-05).
status.title: Status

optInTimestamp.title: Opt In Timestamp
optInTimestamp.description: Opt In Timestamp for this record.

pointsLedgerEntry.title: Points Ledger Entry
pointsLedgerEntry.summary: Immutable, append-only entry recording every points movement (credit, debit, expiry, adjustment).
pointsLedgerEntry.description: PointsLedgerEntry is the authoritative ledger of points movements. Entries are immutable (write-once, no UPDATE/DELETE except for GDPR anonymisation of customerId). balanceAfter records the running balance after the entry was applied. sourceDocument links to the originating event (POS transaction, redemption, expiry batch, manual adjustment). See REQ-LOY-002, REQ-LOY-005, REQ-LOY-009.

customerId.description: Denormalised customerId for GDPR queries; anonymised on deletion.
customerId.title: Customer ID

count.description: Signed delta. Credit positive, debit/expiry negative, adjustment signed.
count.title: Aantal

balanceAfter.description: Running balance AFTER this entry was applied.
balanceAfter.title: Balance After

ruleId.description: Optional FK to PointsRule that produced the credit.
ruleId.title: Regel ID

processedBy.description: Who/what processed the entry (POS terminal id, system, user id).
processedBy.title: Verwerkt Door

redemptionOption.title: Redemption Option
redemptionOption.summary: A reward customers can buy with points (discount, free product, gift card, partner voucher).
redemptionOption.description: RedemptionOption defines what a customer can claim with points. costInPoints is the cost in points; rewardType/rewardValue define the reward; perCustomerLimit caps repeat redemptions. See REQ-LOY-004.

remunerationValue.description: Reward value (number for discount, string for product name, etc.).
remunerationValue.title: Beloning Waarde

oneOf.title: Reward Value (amount)
oneOf.description: Numeric reward value, e.g. a discount amount or percentage.

oneOf.title: Beloning Waarde (tekst)
oneOf.description: Textual reward value, e.g. a product name or voucher code.

costBasisEur.description: Estimated business cost in EUR for cost % reporting (REQ-LOY-008).
costBasisEur.title: Kost Basis Eur

perCustomerLimit.description: Max times one customer can redeem this option (null = unlimited).
perCustomerLimit.title: Per Customer Limit

redemption.title: Redemption
redemption.summary: A claimed reward with status lifecycle (gereserveerd → gebruikt | vervallen | geannuleerd).
redemption.description: Redemption tracks one customer's claim against a RedemptionOption. On initiate, points are debited atomically (immutable PointsLedgerEntry of type 'debit') and a unique rewardCode is issued. Status transitions through gereserveerd → gebruikt (used) | vervallen (expired) | geannuleerd (cancelled, points refunded). See REQ-LOY-004.

redemptionId.title: Redemption ID
redemptionId.description: Unique identifier for the associated redemption.

rewardCode.description: Unique redemption code (UUID-derived, presented to POS).
rewardCode.title: Beloning Code

status.title: Status
status.description: Current lifecycle status of this record.

posTransactionId.title: POS Transaction ID
posTransactionId.description: Unique identifier for the associated pos transaction.

giftCard.title: Gift Card
giftCard.summary: A gift card with hashed PIN and unique serial; balance is mutated via GiftCardTransaction (append-only).
giftCard.description: GiftCard tracks a stored-value instrument with serial (globally unique), PIN (bcrypt hashed, NEVER plaintext — REQ-LOY-006-04), initial balance, current balance, status (issued → active → depleted | blocked), and expiry. All balance movements are logged via GiftCardTransaction. See REQ-LOY-006, REQ-LOY-007.

giftCardId.title: Gift Card ID
giftCardId.description: Unique identifier for the associated gift card.

programmeId.description: FK to LoyaltyProgramme (nullable; gift cards can be standalone).
programmeId.title: Programme ID

pin.description: bcrypt PIN hash — never plaintext, never logged.
pin.title: Pin

giftCardTransaction.title: Gift Card Transaction
giftCardTransaction.summary: Immutable, append-only ledger entry recording every gift-card movement.
giftCardTransaction.description: GiftCardTransaction logs every balance movement (issue, redeem, partial_redeem, refund, topup, block). Append-only — balance changes are reconstructable from the ledger. See REQ-LOY-006, REQ-LOY-007.

transactionId.title: Transaction ID
transactionId.description: Unique identifier for the associated transaction.

giftCardId.title: Gift Card ID
giftCardId.description: Unique identifier for the associated gift card.

posTransactionId.title: POS Transaction ID
posTransactionId.description: Unique identifier for the associated pos transaction.
